description.value: Menya Raizo is a Japanese ramen izakaya on West Broadway in Vancouver, part of the Zakkushi Group which has operated in the city for over 20 years. The restaurant handcrafts its soup, noodles, and cha-shu daily in a central kitchen, and the interior evokes a nostalgic Japanese ramen-ya atmosphere with tin roof, orange bulbs, and lanterns. Touring cyclists can stop in for a hearty bowl of authentic ramen or grab a takeout order on the go.
